purpose: Teach: ジュン/純一郎/愛子/めぐみ/幸子/直樹/哲也/ディック

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「ジュンくんとも仲良くね」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho — your dad was saying you should get along with Jun.
lines.style: Gentle observation, slightly amused. Soft delivery, like sharing a small secret. Warm and knowing, with the faintest smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと小泉純一郎元首相のドキュメンタリー観たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — I watched a documentary about former Prime Minister Koizumi Jun'ichiro with Dad.
lines.style: Bright, eager to share. Quick pace, eyes lighting up. Innocent enthusiasm — he's proud of what he learned. No irony, just genuine.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが皇室の愛子様のニュースを観てらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Sho — your dad's been watching the news about Princess Aiko.
lines.style: Gentle, observant comment. Slightly slower pace. A quiet noticing — not quite curious, just reporting what she's seen. Tender undertone.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとお友達のめぐみちゃんと遊んだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — I played with Dad and my friend Megumi today.
lines.style: Eager and open, building energy. Natural, unforced. The simple joy of reporting good things that happened. Slight breathiness from excitement.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが幸子おばちゃんの誕生日にお花を贈られたわ
lines.en: Sho — your dad sent flowers for Auntie Sachiko's birthday.
lines.style: Soft and warm, with quiet approval in the voice. Slower pace — letting the kindness land. Tender, not sentimental. A small moment of grace.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと隣のお兄さん直樹さんと話したよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — I talked with Dad and Naoki, the older neighbor boy, today.
lines.style: Open and engaged. Steady pace, genuine warmth. Reporting the day with satisfaction — a small social victory. Unguarded.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんとお友達の哲也さんが楽しい方よ
lines.en: Sho — your dad's friend Tetsuya — he's the fun one.
lines.style: Light, reflective, almost wistful. A small knowing smile in the voice. Noticing something good about someone. Warm but measured.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと「ディック・トレーシー」の映画見たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — I watched Dick Tracy with Dad.
lines.style: Pleased and direct. Quick-paced, bright finish. Simple satisfaction in the statement — a good memory, worth reporting. Unguarded closing.
